[Beijing, 2300 Hours, August 8]

[Government Expenses have risen by $60 Billion as a result of the failure of operation Stone Lion].

It was a miserable day, even more so than the last operation. It had rained constantly, thunder boomed and lightning flashed, as if the heavens themselves were making their disapproval known even greater. No matter. What was to be done should help bring China forward further than ever.

The room is set up like last time. In the room is a large, round table, with many figures. There is only one figure on one side of the table – the side for which a seated person would be facing the door, facing East.

“The agents of Operation Stone Lion are… no longer on our side” the figure facing the Eastward door at the table said, “This only indicates how deep the corruption is. I would like you agents to know that if you should become corrupt as well… the punishment will be death. The dishonor of treason will follow your families everywhere”

The figures on the other shifted uncomfortably. The figure that was facing them had a voice that cut them like a steel blade.

“Operation Poet’s Den begins with the new day. Do not disappoint me.”

As the clock struck midnight, the agents stood up and walked out, in a hurry that can only be attributed to stress.
